text:
tara-partnerships: Quick sync — BridgeFlow (ISV) asked for a fast sandbox onramp that includes LangChain + LlamaIndex connectors, a gateway adapter, and packaging artifacts for marketplace storefronts. Can we scope a 2-week pilot? Key asks: adapter shim, sample runner, quickstart + notebook, SI playbook for marketplace onboarding. @nate-eng @li-devex @oliver-pm

nate-eng: We can do the adapter shim + runner in 2 weeks if we constrain scope to the current Gateway API and one model (pick a single 13B-ish quantized variant). Biggest dependency is HW partner validation for INT8/q4 compatibility. @anya-sdks can take sample app.

li-devex: I’ll draft the quickstart + a notebook. Plan to reuse parts of the sandbox flow from last quarter. Need an example routing config and a fallback policy to include.

anya-sdks: I’ll own the sample app + LangChain recipe. Which SDK flavor do we want — sync or async? I recommend async to support streaming and callbacks.

oliver-pm: Marketing flagged a co-announcement window ~3 weeks out. Realistic ask: pilot (2w) -> internal demo -> case study/early-access blog. We should NOT promise full marketplace listing in that window. Any objections?

tara-partnerships: Sounds good. The ask is pilot + joint case study / early-access listing, not GA. Need NimbleCompute (HW partner) to validate quantization on both 3090-class and A100. @partners-bot can you ping them for availability?

partners-bot: Ping sent to @nimble-ops and cc'ed nimble-marketing.

nate-eng: Small blocker — orchx needs a tiny change to support adapter routing per-tenant (routing policy flag). I’ll open a WIP PR today; ETA ~3 days to get CI passing. Also, need a permissive fallback policy for capacity spikes.

li-devex: For the quickstart config, propose this snippet to include in the notebook:

```
adapter:
  name: bridgeflow
  model: llama-2-13b-q4
  fallback: llama-2-7b-compat
routing:
  prefer: latency
  max_batch_ms: 50
```

anya-sdks: Async python it is — I’ll build a LangChain wrapper + LlamaIndex ingest example. Plan: push code to `integrations/bridgeflow-demo` and include a minimal Dockerfile. ETA 5 days.

oliver-pm: Timeline check: Start pilot on Monday (two-week span), internal demo last Friday of week2, marketing draft due Wed of week2. Can everyone confirm those milestones? :calendar:

tara-partnerships: Confirmed. Nate — please post PR when opened. Li — drop quickstart.md in the demo repo. I’ll build the SI playbook template and coordinate with Nimble and our SI partners for a joint run.

nate-eng: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/orchx/pull/234 (WIP). CI failing GPU tests right now — investigating.

li-devex: I’ll add a `scripts/smoke_bridgeflow.sh` to the repo for local dev:

```
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# quick smoke test for bridgeflow
./scripts/start_local_env.sh --adapter bridgeflow
python demos/ingest_and_query.py --example
```

nimble-ops: nimble-ops: We can validate INT8 on A100 and 3090 next Wednesday. Please provide the model artifact (quantized weights + config) and a small loadtest harness (100 concurrent connections, 1s think-time) to run our perf sweep.

tara-partnerships: I’ll drop the model artifact link and the loadtest harness into the repo by EOD today and update the pilot checklist. Thanks everyone — will follow up with a short calendar invite and the milestone tracker :rocket:
